title: TikTok Engagement Rate Calculator
description: Estimate TikTok engagement rate by followers using your average likes, comments and shares. See the formula and limitations before interpreting the result.
intro: Enter your own follower and average interaction counts to calculate a transparent estimate. No account connection is required.

useCases.title: Calculate a follower-based baseline
useCases.description: Combine average likes, comments and shares, then divide by the current follower count using a visible equation.

useCases.title: Audit two calculator results
useCases.description: Check whether another tool used followers, views, a different interaction set or a different recent-post sample.

useCases.title: Document an influencer screen
useCases.description: Record the input averages, denominator and calculation date so a marketer can reproduce the estimate.

examples.title: Follower-based rate
examples.description: Average likes, comments and shares are added together, divided by followers and multiplied by 100.

examples.title: View-based rate
examples.description: Post interactions are divided by sampled views; this answers a different question and must retain its own denominator label.

tips.title: Use one sampling rule
tips.description: Calculate every creator from the same number and type of eligible recent posts before comparing percentages.

tips.title: Inspect outliers
tips.description: Compare the mean with individual post results because one viral or unusually weak post can distort an average.

tips.title: Add decision context
tips.description: Engagement rate alone cannot establish audience fit, sentiment, watch time, conversion quality or commercial value.

faqDescription: Formula choice, denominator labels, input quality and responsible comparison.

faq.question: What does this TikTok engagement calculator do?
faq.answer: It estimates follower-based engagement using the average likes, comments and shares you enter.

faq.question: What formula does the calculator use?
faq.answer: The formula is average likes plus average comments plus average shares, divided by followers, multiplied by 100.

faq.question: Is the result official TikTok data?
faq.answer: No. It is an estimate derived only from your inputs and is not supplied, verified or endorsed by TikTok.

faq.question: Can I compare this result with a view-based rate?
faq.answer: Only when you label the denominator. A view-based rate divides interactions by views, while this calculator divides them by followers. They are not interchangeable.

faq.question: What are the limitations?
faq.answer: Averages can hide variation between posts, public counts may change and follower-based rates do not measure watch time, reach quality or business outcomes.

cards.title: Engagement rate by followers
cards.formula: (Avg likes + Avg comments + Avg shares) ÷ Followers × 100
cards.description: Useful for a consistent, follower-based comparison when every result uses the same definition and sampling method.

cards.title: Engagement rate by views
cards.description: This answers a different question. Always keep the denominator visible when comparing creators or posts.
